crossRefs.note: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.
An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”
For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through…
because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

translations.web: Yahweh knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
translations.bsb: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
translations.kjv: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
translations.asv: Jehovah knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
